mapper.select: SELECT w.current_owner_user AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = w.current_owner_user AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.task_type = #{taskType} AND w.status = 'DONE' AND w.complete_time IS NOT NULL AND w.complete_time >= #{start} AND w.complete_time < #{end} AND w.current_owner_user IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.current_owner_user ORDER BY count DESC, MIN(w.complete_time) ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_type = 'DATA_COLLECTION' AND status NOT IN ('CANCELED','DRAFT') AND (current_owner_user = #{username} OR owner_user = #{username}) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(meta_json, '$.period')) = #{period}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.company_id) FROM company_service cs WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND cs.butler_owner_user = #{butler}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs.company_id) FROM company_service cs JOIN company_bank_statement_upload bsu ON bsu.company_id = cs.company_id AND bsu.period = #{period} AND (COALESCE(bsu.upload_count, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(bsu.no_statement, 0) = 1) WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND cs.butler_owner_user = #{butler}

SELECT cs.butler_owner_user AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.company_id) AS total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bsu.id IS NOT NULL THEN cs.company_id END) AS done_count, ROUND( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bsu.id IS NOT NULL THEN cs.company_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cs.company_id), 0), 2 ) AS rate FROM company_service cs LEFT JOIN company_bank_statement_upload bsu ON bsu.company_id = cs.company_id AND bsu.period = #{period} AND (COALESCE(bsu.upload_count, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(bsu.no_statement, 0) = 1) LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = cs.butler_owner_user AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND cs.butler_owner_user IS NOT NULL AND cs.butler_owner_user != '' GROUP BY cs.butler_owner_user HAVING total_count > 0 ORDER BY rate DESC, done_count DESC

SELECT w.current_owner_user AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS rate FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = w.current_owner_user AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.task_type = #{taskType} AND w.status NOT IN ('CANCELED','DRAFT') AND w.current_owner_user IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.current_owner_user HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY rate DESC, done_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM field_work_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND assignee_id = #{userId} AND status <> 'CANCELLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM field_work_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND assignee_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM field_work_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND assignee_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') AND update_time < NOW() - INTERVAL #{staleDays} DAY

SELECT create_time AS createTime, actual_end_time AS completeTime FROM field_work_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND assignee_id = #{userId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND actual_end_time IS NOT NULL AND create_time IS NOT NULL AND actual_end_time >= #{start} AND actual_end_time < #{end}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.final_amount), 0) FROM work_order w JOIN orders o ON o.id = w.order_id AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.status = 'PAID' WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.task_type = 'RENEWAL' AND w.status = 'DONE' AND w.complete_time IS NOT NULL AND w.complete_time >= #{start} AND w.complete_time < #{end} AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{u} OR w.owner_user IN #{u})

SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_CHILD','SUSPENDED','CONCESSION_DONE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'DONE' AND w.complete_time IS NOT NULL AND w.complete_time >= #{monthStart} AND w.complete_time < #{monthEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_done, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_CHILD','SUSPENDED','CONCESSION_DONE') AND w.update_time < NOW() - INTERVAL #{staleDays} DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stale_count FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.task_type = 'BOOKKEEPING' AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR w.owner_user IN #{x}) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) ORDER BY active_count DESC

SELECT COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','WAITING_CHILD','SUSPENDED','CONCESSION_DONE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'DONE' AND w.complete_time IS NOT NULL AND w.complete_time >= #{monthStart} AND w.complete_time < #{monthEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_done, SUM(CASE WHEN w.due_time IS NOT NULL AND w.due_time < #{now} AND w.status NOT IN ('DONE','CANCELED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_count FROM work_order w LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.task_type = 'RENEWAL' AND (w.current_owner_user IN #{x} OR w.owner_user IN #{x}) GROUP BY COALESCE(w.current_owner_user, w.owner_user) ORDER BY active_count DESC

SELECT cs.butler_owner_user AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.company_id) AS total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bsu.id IS NOT NULL THEN cs.company_id END) AS done_count FROM company_service cs LEFT JOIN company_bank_statement_upload bsu ON bsu.company_id = cs.company_id AND bsu.period = #{period} AND (COALESCE(bsu.upload_count,0) > 0 OR COALESCE(bsu.no_statement,0) = 1) LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username = cs.butler_owner_user AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND cs.butler_owner_user IN #{x} GROUP BY cs.butler_owner_user ORDER BY done_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM field_work_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status <> 'CANCELLED' AND assignee_id IN #{i}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM field_work_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') AND assignee_id IN #{i}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM field_work_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') AND update_time < NOW() - INTERVAL #{staleDays} DAY AND assignee_id IN #{i}

SELECT create_time AS createTime, actual_end_time AS completeTime FROM field_work_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND actual_end_time IS NOT NULL AND create_time IS NOT NULL AND actual_end_time >= #{start} AND actual_end_time < #{end} AND assignee_id IN #{i}

SELECT u.username AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN f.status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN f.status = 'COMPLETED' AND f.actual_end_time IS NOT NULL AND f.actual_end_time >= #{monthStart} AND f.actual_end_time < #{monthEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_done, SUM(CASE WHEN f.status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') AND f.update_time < NOW() - INTERVAL #{staleDays} DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stale_count FROM field_work_task f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.assignee_id AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.assignee_id IN #{i} GROUP BY u.username ORDER BY active_count DESC

SELECT u.username AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM field_work_task f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.assignee_id AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND f.status = 'COMPLETED' AND f.actual_end_time IS NOT NULL AND f.actual_end_time >= #{start} AND f.actual_end_time < #{end} GROUP BY u.username ORDER BY count DESC, MIN(f.actual_end_time) ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.final_amount), 0) FROM work_order w JOIN orders o ON o.id = w.order_id AND o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND o.status = 'PAID' WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.task_type = 'RENEWAL' AND w.status = 'DONE' AND w.complete_time IS NOT NULL AND w.complete_time >= #{start} AND w.complete_time < #{end} AND (w.current_owner_user = #{username} OR w.owner_user = #{username})
